title: Mass and motion energy
hook: Change mass and predict kinetic energy.
misconception: kinetic energy stays fixed when mass doubles.
objective: Apply K = ½mv² to compare kinetic energy when mass changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a moving object at fixed speed, K = ½mv². When mass doubles, kinetic energy becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model K = ½mv²; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a moving object at fixed speed, with a nonzero initial result. If mass triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on kinetic energy?
recall.why: Apply K = ½mv² under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
